title.zh: 授权邦板牙省议会向Apalit市镇提供不超过1,000菲律宾比索的贷款，用于在该市镇建造手工训练学校的法案
title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PROVINCIAL BOARD OF PAMPANGA TO MAKE A LOAN OF NOT MORE THAN ONE THOUSAND PHILIPPINE PESOS TO THE MUNICIPALITY OF APALIT, TO BE USED IN THE CONSTRUCTION OF A MANUAL-TRAINING SCHOOL IN SAID MUNICIPALITY.
title.orig: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PROVINCIAL BOARD OF PAMPANGA TO MAKE A LOAN OF NOT MORE THAN ONE THOUSAND PHILIPPINE PESOS TO THE MUNICIPALITY OF APALIT, TO BE USED IN THE CONSTRUCTION OF A MANUAL-TRAINING SCHOOL IN SAID MUNICIPALITY.
title.vi: Luật cho phép Hội đồng tỉnh Pampanga cho đô thị Apalit vay tối đa 1.000 peso Philippines để xây dựng trường đào tạo thủ công
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้อำนาจคณะกรรมการจังหวัด Pampanga ให้เทศบาล Apalit กู้เงินไม่เกิน 1,000 เปโซฟิลิปปินส์เพื่อสร้างโรงเรียนฝึกทักษะงานช่าง
title.id: Undang-Undang memberi wewenang kepada Dewan Provinsi Pampanga untuk meminjamkan paling banyak 1.000 peso Filipina kepada munisipalitas Apalit guna membangun sekolah pelatihan keterampilan manual
title.ms: Akta membenarkan Lembaga Wilayah Pampanga memberi pinjaman tidak melebihi 1,000 peso Filipina kepada perbandaran Apalit untuk membina sekolah latihan kemahiran tangan

text.en:
The provincial board of Pampanga is hereby authorized to divert not more than out thousand
Philippine pesos, from any provincial fund not otherwise appropriated, as a loan to the municipality of
Apalit, to be used in the roust action of a manual-training school in said municipality, such loan to be repaid,
without interest, in two equal yearly installments, the first to be paid on or before June thirtieth, nineteen
hundred and five, and the second on or before June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and six.

The manual-training school for which provision is made in the preceding section shall be
constructed only on plans to be drawn by the Chief of the Bureau of Architecture and Construction of Public
Buildings, approved by the General Superintendent of Education, and under the supervision of the provincial
board of Pampanga.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, July 19, 1901.
